resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com's banner reads R.I.P. 1924-1935, which conflicts with its own 1950 text. Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give 1950, so the story uses 1950. The banner's end year matches the 1935 replacement, which may explain it, but no source says so.

notes_for_editor: Record facts hold up: gone per the firelookout.org list, Nez Perce NF, Idaho County. Staffing 1939 to 1941 rests on one source (Idaho Fire Lookouts citing a former registry). The L-4 dimensions come from a general Nez Perce NF publication, not a site-specific record. The trailhead page is cited only for the road and trail; it does not describe the lookout site. Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up Abandoned / Destroyed, which the story reports as a label only; the trailhead page does not describe the lookout site. No new photos added. Revised 2026-10-10: 'first lookout' is now 'earliest lookout on record'; the L-4 sentence is reworded so it no longer copies the Forest Service quote.
